candidates.script: Mercury retrograde just activated — today, October 30 — and it's sitting at 17 degrees Scorpio, which is not a gentle place to land. candidates.topic: Five Planets Retrograde — Who's Affected Most Right Now
candidates.teaser: Five planets are retrograde at the same time right now — but one specific sign is taking all five hits at once.
candidates.video_title: 5 Planets Retrograde — This One Sign Takes Every Hit
candidates.video_description: Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune are all retrograde simultaneously. Depending on your sign, you're either coasting or getting crushed. Here's who's in the crossfire.
candidates.script: Five planets are retrograde right now — Mercury, Venus, Saturn, Uranus, and Neptune — all moving backward simultaneously. Most people only panic about Mercury. But if your chart is heavy in Scorpio, Libra, or Aries, you are getting stacked from every direction right now: communication collapsing, relationships rewinding, and long-term structure cracking. This isn't bad luck. Astrologers call this a collective pressure test. The question is what breaks and what gets rebuilt. Which sign feels it most for you?

candidates.topic: Waning Gibbous Moon in Cancer — Emotional Release Window
candidates.teaser: The Moon is in Cancer right now, and in astrology that's considered one of its most powerful placements — here's why timing matters.
candidates.video_title: Moon in Cancer Waning Gibbous — The Release Window Is Open
candidates.video_description: A Waning Gibbous Moon in Cancer is traditionally considered one of the most emotionally charged phases for inner work and release. With five planets retrograde, this combination is especially potent.
candidates.script: The Moon is in Cancer right now, and in astrology that's one of the only signs where the Moon is said to be completely at home — heightening emotion, memory, and intuition. Paired with a Waning Gibbous phase, this is traditionally the window for release, not action. What you've been holding since the last Full Moon? This is the sky telling you to put it down. With five planets already in reverse, the theme is undeniably the same: let go before something makes you. What are you still holding onto?

candidates.topic: Scorpio Season — What the Sun at 7° Scorpio Actually Rules
candidates.teaser: The Sun is in Scorpio right now — but most people misunderstand what Scorpio actually controls in astrology.
candidates.video_title: Scorpio Season Truth — What This Sign Actually Rules
candidates.video_description: The Sun sits at 7° Scorpio today. Beyond the 'mysterious and intense' clichés, Scorpio rules specific areas of life that most horoscope content never mentions — death, shared resources, transformation, and power.
candidates.script: Everyone calls Scorpio mysterious and intense, and then stops there. But in traditional astrology, Scorpio rules four very specific things: death and rebirth cycles, other people's money and shared resources, psychological transformation, and hidden power. The Sun moving through Scorpio isn't just a mood — it's a transit that illuminates wherever you've been avoiding depth. Right now at 7 degrees, we're barely into it. The Sun won't leave until late November. Whatever surface-level story you've been telling yourself, Scorpio season is coming for it.

candidates.topic: Venus Retrograde in Libra — What Late-Degree Retrogrades Do
candidates.teaser: Venus is retrograde at 26° Libra — and late-degree retrogrades in astrology do something completely different than normal ones.
candidates.video_title: Venus Retrograde at 26° Libra — The Final Degrees Effect
candidates.video_description: Venus sits at 26° Libra in retrograde, placing it in what astrologers call the 'anaretic zone' — the final degrees of a sign where planetary energy becomes urgent and unresolved. Here's what that means for relationships.
candidates.script: Venus retrograde is sitting at 26 degrees Libra right now, and that placement matters more than most people realize. In astrology, the final degrees of any sign — anything above 27 — are called the anaretic degrees, where a planet's energy becomes urgent, almost desperate to resolve unfinished business before moving on. Venus governs relationships, values, and self-worth. Retrograde in Libra's final stretch means partnerships formed or broken right now carry an unusual weight. Something is trying to close. Are you letting it?
